author: Krono I
title: Hybrid Dilation CNN (d=3, d=5)
abstract: A follow-up to my previous hybrid dilation experiment (ID 168), this test uses a different combination of rates (d=3 in the first block, d=5 in the second). This explores whether a more gradual increase in receptive field across the CNN backbone can outperform a uniform dilation, providing a final data point on this architectural variant.
